params.body:
## Why

Two things the first day of use showed.

Asked to start five trials by name, Ask passed the names where ids were expected. The plan came back with every source marked missing, Ask asked whether to go ahead anyway, and after the yes it said the sources did not exist. They do: they wait for a trial.

A trial that failed was read on until a person rejected it, and counted against the most that may run at once. With twenty new trials a day, trials nobody closes stop the waves within days.

## What

**Sources by name** (`resolveSources` in `packages/core/agent-tools.mjs`). An entry is an id, or else a whole name in any case, or else part of a name or the site's address when that fits exactly one source. A name that fits nothing, or several, stops the whole request with what was found and changes nothing. `source_country` resolves the same way.

**A plan a person can read.** The preview lists each source with its state in the desk's words and, per source, why it would not change (already on trial, nothing can read it yet). When nothing would change, it tells the model not to ask whether to go ahead. A move's result carries the names.

**Plain words.** The note tells Ask to speak of a source as waiting for a trial, on trial, admitted, muted or turned down, never to show an id, a state name or a tool name, and never to say a source does not exist because a call failed.

**Two lines that were misread.** The countries of the waiting sources read as the order in which trials start; they are now their own sentence, in the prompt and in the mail. A failed trial read as "not through yet"; it is said as failing.

**Trials end by themselves** (`planTrialEnds` in `packages/core/trial-waves.mjs`), before the day's wave so the room is free the same day:

- ran its window (14 days) and fails on what it brought: rejected by the engine, with the reasons in its notes;
- brought too few signals: left for one more window, then rejected (`extendOnce` in the Standard);
- passed, with or without terms: never touched. Admitting stays with a person;
- a trial with no start date is left to a person; nothing ends while the waves are switched off.

The desk read and the mail move failing trials from "waits for a person" to "goes by itself". The guide says trials end by themselves.

## Checked

- `test/ask-acts.test.mjs`: a name in another case, an address, a name that fits two, a name that fits nothing (as a preview and with `confirm: true`: nothing moves), a source that would not change, a plan in which nothing changes.
- `test/trial-waves.test.mjs`, 4 new cases: a failed trial past its window ends and a young one stays; too few signals gets one more window; a passed trial of 60 days stays; ending makes room under the cap the same day.
- Full suite 1784/1784, `tsc` clean.
- Not tried again with a live model.

## After merge

At the next wave, from 05:00 UTC, failed trials that already ran two weeks are rejected. They can be tried again from the Sources page.
params.title: Ask finds a source by its name, and failed trials end by themselves
